verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's search/marketplace lets engineers query live GPU offers by type, count, and other specs before renting (vast-ai-docs-41, vast-ai-docs-51, vast-ai-docs-20, vast-ai-gh-1), directly enabling pre-provisioning visibility into availability rather than failing at launch. However, evidence doesn't explicitly show region as a filter dimension, and community reports note instance reliability sometimes diverges from what's shown in the console (vast-ai-comm-6), suggesting search results aren't always a perfect predictor of real provisioning success. Missing for 10: explicit region/geography filter in search docs, real-time freshness guarantees, and independent corroboration that search results reliably prevent stockout failures.
